item.tib: khro mchog 'dus pa sde brgyad 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las btsan rje wer ro gnad kyi khol sgrub yang snying
item.coloph: ces khro mchog 'dus pa sde brgyad 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las btsan rje wer ro gnad kyi khol sgrub yang snying zhes bya 'di nyid mdo khams smad kyi gnas mchog brag dkar bya rgod gsang ba'i mdun zhol nyi shar brag gi g.yas rgyab dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i bka' rtags zhabs rjes kyi g.yon mdun nor bu rdzong gi byang ngos rang 'byung sgrol mas gsang lung gis che mchog rta mgrin rol pa'i brag gtso 'khor gyi tshul du bzhengs shing bka' rtags rta dbu 'dra ba'i mar zhabs sked gsang ska rags 'dra ba'i khung seng zhes pa nas sa stag lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gcig gi tho rangs dus su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rang 'byung sgrol ma dang gter bdag lha btsan rgyal pos lung bstan nas kho bo phyogs med kyi rnal mkha' 'gro'i gsang lung gis gsang bdag ye shes mgon po zhes bya ba 'byor ba gtsug phud rnam rgyal du 'bod pas bdag gis dngos grub tu brnyed nas slar mda' chen dkar mo ri khrod du slebs tshe rig 'dzin dmu tsa dra (tra) he'i rnam rol skyang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nam kun gsal mtshan can de dang khong gi grwa slob dam pa rin chen dang rang gi grogs mched rin chen la sogs kyis bskul ngor dang rten 'brel ngo mtshar dang ldan ldan pa mang du byung bas shog ser brda don bdun pa can nas yig ris phab pa 'dis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rno so ru gyur cig/
